messages.content:
You are assisting with business process modelling. A first check could not decide whether the conditions in the list below hold for the business process described below. They are conditions of the rule [CRD-Art14-1]. Look again.

INSTRUCTIONS
- The legal passages below are all the rules found for this process. Use them only to understand what a condition means (for example a definition of a word). Whether a condition holds must still be shown by the process description.
- For each condition, choose its status:
  - "confirmed": the description states that it holds. A statement in legal terms is "confirmed" when the description states the same fact in everyday words.
  - "contradicted": the description states something that makes it false.
  - "not_stated": use this only when no sentence of the description speaks to the statement.
- "confirmed" needs a quote that itself states that fact; a sentence about a different event never confirms it.
- Do not guess facts the description does not state.
- quotes: for "confirmed" or "contradicted", a list of 1 to 3 sentences of the process description that together show it, each copied exactly and word for word. Use more than one sentence only when the fact is stated across several sentences. For "not_stated", use an empty list []. Quotes are checked automatically; a quote that does not appear in the description is ignored, and an item with no such quote counts as "not_stated".
- Give one result for every condition, with its id, and no other results.
- Answer with one JSON object that follows the JSON schema below. Output only the JSON, with no other text.

EXAMPLE OF EVERYDAY WORDS (made up, from another domain)
Statement: "C1: the vessel has obtained clearance for departure from the port authority"
Description sentence: "The harbour master tells the captain that the ship may leave."
Result: "confirmed", quotes ["The harbour master tells the captain that the ship may leave"] (the same fact in everyday words). The sentence "The crew loads the cargo." speaks about a different event and would not confirm it.

JSON SCHEMA
{
  "$defs": {
    "ItemCheck": {
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "description": "The id of the item, as given in the list",
          "title": "Id",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "closest_sentence": {
          "anyOf": [
            {
              "type": "string"
            },
            {
              "type": "null"
            }
          ],
          "description": "The sentence of the process description that comes closest to the statement, copied word for word, or null if none",
          "title": "Closest Sentence"
        },
        "status": {
          "description": "confirmed, contradicted or not_stated, judged from the description only",
          "enum": [
            "confirmed",
            "not_stated",
            "contradicted"
          ],
          "title": "Status",
          "type": "string"
        },
        "quotes": {
          "description": "1 to 3 sentences copied word for word from the process description that together show the status; empty list for not_stated",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "maxItems": 3,
          "title": "Quotes",
          "type": "array"
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "id",
        "closest_sentence",
        "status",
        "quotes"
      ],
      "title": "ItemCheck",
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "properties": {
    "results": {
      "description": "One result for every item of the list",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/ItemCheck"
      },
      "title": "Results",
      "type": "array"
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "results"
  ],
  "title": "CheckOutputV2",
  "type": "object"
}

PROCESS DESCRIPTION
An e-commerce company has a comprehensive order fulfillment process:
When a customer places an order, the system records the order details.
Payment processing begins.
If the payment fails, the customer is notified, and the process ends.
Upon successful payment, the inventory system checks stock availability.
If items are out of stock, a back-order is initiated, and the customer is informed about the delay.
The process continues once the back-order is received and all required items are available in stock.
In-stock items are picked from the warehouse.
Quality control checks are performed on the picked items.
Packaging is done, including gift wrapping if the customer requested it.
Meanwhile, the shipping department prepares shipping documents and labels.
If the order is international, customs documentation is prepared.
Once packaging and shipping documents are ready, the order is dispatched.
The system sends a shipping confirmation to the customer.
After dispatch, the system updates the inventory levels.
A follow-up email for feedback is sent directly after confirming the successful delivery.
If the customer reports any issues upon delivery, a returns process is initiated, which includes:
Sending a return shipping label.
Receiving returned items.
Inspecting returned items.
Processing a refund or replacement.
The customers are private persons in several EU countries. Some customers contact the company a few days after delivery only because they no longer want the items, without reporting any issue.

LEGAL PASSAGES
[CRD-Art14-2] Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 14: Obligations of the consumer in the event of withdrawal
2. The consumer shall only be liable for any diminished value of the goods resulting from the handling of the goods other than what is necessary to establish the nature, characteristics and functioning of the goods. The consumer shall in any event not be liable for diminished value of the goods where the trader has failed to provide notice of the right of withdrawal in accordance with point (h) of Article 6(1).

[CRD-Art14-2a] Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 14: Obligations of the consumer in the event of withdrawal
2a. In the event of withdrawal from the contract, the consumer shall refrain from using the digital content or digital service and from making it available to third parties.

[CRD-Art14-3] Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 14: Obligations of the consumer in the event of withdrawal
3. Where a consumer exercises the right of withdrawal after having made a request in accordance with Article 7(3) or Article 8(8), the consumer shall pay to the trader an amount which is in proportion to what has been provided until the time the consumer has informed the trader of the exercise of the right of withdrawal, in comparison with the full coverage of the contract. The proportionate amount to be paid by the consumer to the trader shall be calculated on the basis of the total price agreed in the contract. If the total price is excessive, the proportionate amount shall be calculated on the basis of the market value of what has been provided.

[CRD-Art14-4] Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 14: Obligations of the consumer in the event of withdrawal
4. The consumer shall bear no cost for:
(a) the performance of services or the supply of water, gas or electricity, where they are not put up for sale in a limited volume or set quantity, or of district heating, in full or in part, during the withdrawal period, where:
(i) the trader has failed to provide information in accordance with points (h) or (j) of Article 6(1); or
(ii) the consumer has not expressly requested performance to begin during the withdrawal period in accordance with Article 7(3) and Article 8(8); or
(b) the supply, in full or in part, of digital content which is not supplied on a tangible medium where:
(i) the consumer has not given prior express consent to the beginning of the performance before the end of the 14-day or 30-day period referred to in Article 9;
(ii) the consumer has not acknowledged that he loses his right of withdrawal when giving his consent; or
(iii) the trader has failed to provide confirmation in accordance with Article 7(2) or Article 8(7).

[CRD-Art14-5] Consumer Rights Directive (2011/83/EU) - Article 14: Obligations of the consumer in the event of withdrawal
5. Except as provided for in Article 13(2) and in this Article, the consumer shall not incur any liability as a consequence of the exercise of the right of withdrawal.

CONDITIONS
C1: its customer has communicated his decision to withdraw from the contract to the organisation running the described process in accordance with Article 11
C2: the organisation running the described process has not offered to collect the goods himself
C3: the contract is an off-premises contract
C4: the goods have been delivered to its customer’s home at the time of the conclusion of the contract
C5: by their nature, those goods cannot normally be returned by post
